srcName: AI News catch-up 2026-09-18 - WebAssembly showcase (BrowserPod, PGlite)
b: Browser-native sandbox from Leaning Technologies that runs Linux applications (Node, Rust, C++, Python preview) compiled to Wasm, with a persistent virtual filesystem, controlled networking, parallelism and multithreading - its makers call it an OS kernel for the web platform. Two claims worth testing: you target it directly instead of rewriting against WASI, and disk images stream block-by-block so only the parts of a stdlib you actually use get downloaded. That is a container-free execution lane for anything Djeli or Prism needs to run untrusted.
tg: browser-native sandbox for running agent output without a container
